current_repo_gaps.name: Current documentation and repo retrieval inside Cursor
current_repo_gaps.why_it_exists: The repo already values research-first implementation, but current repo and doc lookup still rely heavily on shell search plus manual browsing.

current_repo_gaps.name: Browser augmentation beyond the local Safari/macOS path
current_repo_gaps.why_it_exists: The runtime is strong on local macOS control, but a bounded external browser/testing surface could improve reproducibility and experiments.

current_repo_gaps.name: Cursor-native observability and evaluation access
current_repo_gaps.why_it_exists: The repo has strong traces and evaluation artifacts, but they are not exposed as native Cursor tools.

current_repo_gaps.name: MCP governance and secret discipline
current_repo_gaps.why_it_exists: Adopting more MCPs introduces governance, audit, and secret-handling pressure not covered by install convenience alone.

current_repo_gaps.why_it_exists: The repo values screenshots, reference boards, and visual evidence, but current Cursor integration is version-gated for MCP Apps.
